vocabulary.example: The inventor came up with an ingenious solution to the problem.

vocabulary.definition: pleasure derived by someone from another person's misfortune
vocabulary.example: She couldn't help but feel a sense of schadenfreude when her rival failed.
The old computer system became obsolete after the new upgrade.

vocabulary.definition: a figure of speech in which a word or phrase is applied to an object or action to which it is not literally applicable
vocabulary.example: His words were a powerful metaphor for the struggles of life.
The word 'short' is an autological word because it is short.
